answer_1.quote: Work on grounded instruction following has recently been driven by sequence-to-sequence models, which allow end-to-end grounding of linguistically-rich instructions into equally-rich visual contexts.
answer_1.outputs: actions to carry out instructions conditioning on image observations

answer_2.quote: We measure success rates over full trajectories as well as over each subgoal type independently... Success rates are weighted by path lengths to penalize successful trajectories which are longer than the ground-truth demonstration trajectory. To evaluate full trajectories, we measure path completion: the portion of subgoals completed within the full trajectories.
automatic_metrics: weighted success rate by path length
